description: Base Renovate preset for @unabandoned forks: keep dependencies current, soak new releases before adopting them, automerge once green, pin the supply chain, flag anything that itself becomes abandoned, and fast-track security fixes.

packageRules.description: Auto-merge Renovate PRs that bump our own first-party config repos - the unabandoned/.github reusable-workflow digest ('commit tag') pins and the unabandoned/renovate-config preset. These are internal and reviewed at source, so adopt them immediately on green with no soak. They land as `chore(deps)` (CI-only, not `fix`), so release-please never cuts a release for them. They go through a PR, not branch automerge: every fork's CI runs only on pushes to its default branch and on pull requests, so a bare renovate/* branch never gets a status check and branch automerge waited on it forever.
